purpose: Audit the official/institutional secondary-research sweep for Centru, Sud-Muntenia and Sud-Vest Oltenia without promoting project activity, funding supply or technology deployment as evidence of AI4WORK need prevalence.

promoted_source.title: Prognoza angajarilor pe termen scurt - Judetul Covasna (eSPOR)
promoted_source.methodology: online employer questionnaire with branch-level representation thresholds and staged contact; the report states minimum employer/share thresholds by branch and later emphasis on employers with more than 50 employees
source_reported_context: more than 35% of estimated hires are reported in skilled-worker occupations
53% of extrapolated hires are reported as not requiring prior experience, only vocational training
promoted_source.internal_discrepancy: The introduction and employer-size table report 2,029 estimated hires, while the results paragraph and ownership table report 1,371. No hire-total value is reconciled by assumption or used in AI4WORK ranking.
limitations: historical forecast rather than 2026 AI4WORK primary evidence
later contact emphasis on employers with more than 50 employees may affect response composition
not a prevalence measure for AI4WORK 2026 target populations

fresh_follow_up_screening.title: Prognoza angajarilor pe termen scurt - Judetul Covasna (eSPOR)
fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: Actual report content was read back. The report documents 737 employers approached, 406 respondents, explicit branch-level sampling thresholds and staged contact. It also contains a material internal discrepancy between 1,371 and 2,029 estimated hires.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: This is real official employer-survey evidence with auditable methodology, but it is historical, county-level and not AI/digital-specific. The conflicting hire totals are preserved as a source limitation rather than reconciled.

fresh_follow_up_screening.title: Proiecte europene pentru administratii publice locale mai conectate cu cetatenii din Brasov, Codlea si Zarnesti
fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: The 28 August 2026 institutional communication reports AI, Digital Twin and e-government implementation projects.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: Technology deployment and funded implementation do not measure adult or employer need prevalence.

fresh_follow_up_screening.title: GREEN JOBS PRAHOVA - Tranzitie catre o economie verde
fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: The current page describes a 2026 transition and skills-update project.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: A funded project's objectives, target groups and planned skills activity are supply/implementation context and cannot be used as proof of underlying need.

fresh_follow_up_screening.title: Lansare proiect - GREEN SPO / tranzitie spre economie verde
fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: The current official page reports a 2026 project launch and planned employment/training measures.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: Project launch, target-group and implementation information is explicitly not accepted as proof of need under NF-RUN-001.

refresh_conclusion: S39 is now the source-register high-water mark. It adds real official employer-survey evidence for Centru, but only as historical direct-complementary context with zero H1-H5 effect. Its internal 1,371 versus 2,029 estimated-hire discrepancy is preserved and prevents use of a reconciled hire total. Current project/funding/digitalisation communications in all three target regions remain context only and are not promoted as need evidence.
next_refresh_rule: Promote a new source only when actual content is readable and provides materially stronger target-population evidence with enough provenance and method detail to classify its limits. A listing, project objective, funding offer, technology deployment or training activity is insufficient.

call_requirements_refresh.connected_mail_query_scope: after:2026/09/02 (OMIPE OR MIPE OR PEO OR 1302 OR Anexa 4 OR AI4WORK), excluding spam/trash and GitHub notifications
